rationale: Candidate-exact supplemental official NYC DOT review found only historical B6 context: a 2010 existing-conditions table places a B6 westbound maximum-load point at Glenwood Road and Nostrand Avenue. That intersection context predates the candidate date and does not bind B6 to the 2018 Glenwood Road bus-lane project, its exact five westbound feature rows, or candidate-date traversal. The later enforcement report lists Glenwood Road but names no route. Attribution and traversal remain unresolved; no occurrence, study, or cross-product projection is authorized.
